research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Corelight is researching methods for analyzing network traffic, specifically focusing on identifying authentication methods within secure shell (SSH) data. The work described in 'System and method for identifying authentication method of secure shell (ssh)' details a process where a processor receives SSH session data and detects communication patterns related to SSH authentication. This highlights Corelight’s focus on network traffic analysis and secure authentication detection.

overview_description.description:
Corelight offers network traffic analysis solutions for cybersecurity. It helps security professionals to understand network traffic and to detect and stop cyberattacks. Its solution was built on Bro, a widely-used open-source framework that provides a real-time understanding of network traffic.

The company was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

about_short_description.short_description: Corelight is a cybersecurity company specializing in network traffic analysis (NTA) solutions.

product.name: Corelight Open NDR Platform
product.description: A network detection and response platform that converts on-premises, cloud, and hybrid network traffic into evidence for threat detection, investigation, threat hunting, and response.

product.name: Corelight Sensors
product.description: Network traffic sensors that collect and analyze traffic from physical, cloud, virtual, and software-defined environments, producing Zeek-based network evidence for security and operations teams.

product.name: Corelight Investigator
product.description: A SaaS-based network detection and response application for evidence-first alert triage, investigation, threat hunting, and incident response.

product.name: Corelight Analytics & Detections
product.description: A multilayer detection capability combining signatures, threat intelligence, behavioral analytics, machine learning, anomaly detection, and MITRE ATT&CK-aligned detections.

product.name: Corelight Performance & Asset Visibility
product.description: A network-based visibility product that passively classifies assets and identifies anomalous network performance using data collected by Corelight Sensors.

product.name: Corelight Smart PCAP
product.description: A packet-capture capability that selectively stores traffic relevant to investigations, extending the historical evidence available for threat detection and forensic analysis.
